dedupe_keys.name: fmi solar laboratory pv meteorology and snow data 2015 2021

description: The Finnish Meteorological Institute publishes measured photovoltaic production and accompanying weather data from its solar laboratories in Helsinki, Kuopio and Sodankylä. The collection spans August 2015 to December 2021, with individual systems starting at different dates. Four semicolon-separated CSV files cover Helsinki, Kuopio and two differently tilted Sodankylä modules. Most power observations have one-minute resolution; early Sodankylä records have five-minute sampling. The repository also lists daily diagnostic plots, hourly module photographs, site metadata and equipment information in compressed archives. It documents variable header lengths for loading the CSV files in Python. Access is open without registration and free under Creative Commons Attribution; the repository rights field does not state a licence version. Snow classifications and quality flags support calibration of photovoltaic performance and snow-loss models. Missing readings, shading and equipment faults limit interpretation as ideal generation curves. The measurements complement weather-derived generation estimates with observations from a few high-latitude installations. They do not represent Finland’s entire solar fleet.
